blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Нам следовало бы залатать дыру в сетке, ___ (or else) весь дом будет полон мух.
exercises.prompt: We'd better get the hole in the screen fixed or the house will be full of flies.
exercises.why: **а то** — «or else»: а то warns what happens otherwise.

exercises.q: Не кривляйся, ___ (or else) так и останешься.
exercises.prompt: Don't make that face or it's going to get stuck like that.
exercises.why: **а то** — «or else»: а то warns what happens otherwise.

exercises.prompt: Close the windows. Otherwise, mosquitoes will get in.
exercises.why: **а то** — «or else»: а то warns what happens otherwise.

exercises.prompt: Snow is cold, but also beautiful.
exercises.why: **зато** — «but then»: зато sets a gain against a loss.
**Зато** — «but then»: зато sets a gain against a loss.

exercises.q: Мы провозились три недели с починкой машины, но ___ (but then) она теперь бегает сносно.
exercises.prompt: It's taken us three weeks to fix, but at last our car runs satisfactorily.
exercises.why: **зато** — «but then»: зато sets a gain against a loss.
